item.name: Bulk create analytical axes for an entity.

request.name: Bulk create analytical axes for an entity.

description.content:
Create multiple analytical axes with their codes in a single call.

Each axe is processed independently: if one fails, the others are still created.

The response contains a per-item report indicating success or failure for each axe.
